 View CCSS | NGSS Veterans Day is celebrated annually on November 11 (Credit: Defense.gov/ Public Domain) Veterans Day is celebrated annually on November 11. It honors the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. This includes members of the US Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force, Space Force, and Coast Guard.
 The federal holiday is often confused with Memorial Day, which falls on the last Monday of May. While both honor the US military , they serve different purposes. Memorial Day commemorates US soldiers who died while serving. Veterans Day celebrates all American soldiers — both living and deceased . But its primary purpose is to thank living veterans for their service. 
 The difference between Memorial Day and Veterans Day (Credit: News.va.gov/ Public Domain) The holiday was initially called Armistice Day. US President Woodrow Wilson established it on November 11, 1919, to honor soldiers who served in World War I. The date marked the first anniversary of the November 11, 1918, armistice between the Allied Nations and Germany . This agreement led to the 1919 Treaty of Versailles, which officially ended the war. In 1954, Armistice Day was renamed Veterans Day to include all Americans who had served in the US military.
 Veterans Day remained on November 11 until the passage of the 1968 Uniform Holiday Bill. The law moved several federal holidays to Mondays to give Americans more three-day weekends. Beginning in 1971, Veterans Day was moved to the fourth Monday in October.
 However, due to the date's historical importance, many states continued to observe it on November 11. In 1975, President Gerald Ford signed a law restoring Veterans Day to its original date. The change took effect in 1978. Since then, Veterans Day has been observed on November 11.
 Veterans Day Parade in New York City (Credit: Darius Radzius/ Military.com/ Public Domain) Many other countries also honor their soldiers on November 11. France and New Zealand continue to observe it as Armistice Day. The UK, Australia, and Canada call it Remembrance Day. In the UK, the main celebration takes place on the Sunday closest to November 11.
 There are many ways to show your appreciation for veterans on this special day. You can participate in your local parade or donate food and supplies to veterans' centers. Even better, spend time reading to or talking with elderly or injured veterans. Other options include volunteering with veterans' organizations or sending care packages and letters to those still serving.
